name: build
title: wsync build
description: Serializes the project tree into a Roblox place or model file, optionally rebuilding on every change.
notes: Requires a project. It builds from the in-memory tree with no filesystem rescan and never starts, contacts, or requires a daemon or the Studio plugin.
A `DataModel` root produces a place (`.rbxl`, or `.rbxlx` with `--xml`); any other root produces a model (`.rbxm`, or `.rbxmx` with `--xml`). An explicit `--output` extension wins over `--xml`.
`--plugin` writes the built model into the local Roblox Studio plugins directory instead of the project, which is how a `plugin` template is tested.
`--watch` stays in the foreground and rebuilds off the internal change bus; add `--sourcemap` to keep the sourcemap regenerated alongside each build.
`--ts` enables the roblox-ts passthrough for TypeScript projects.
The output is a build artifact, not a sync surface: writing it back into the project does not push anything to Studio.
